card.name: The word syndrome after serotonin
card.fires_on: The word 'syndrome' right after 'serotonin' in drug interaction warnings. Also fires on 'interaction' or a split 'communiqué' after a joining word.

modes.label: Serotonin syndrome
modes.description: The word 'syndrome' completing 'serotonin syndrome' in antidepressant and MAOI interaction text.
modes.example: with MAOIs increases the risk of serotonin<< syndrome>>. Intervention Concomitant use of Ven

modes.label: Joint or interaction nouns
modes.description: A noun about combined action, such as 'interaction' or the start of 'communiqué' after 'joint'.
modes.example: concentration is at least 3 ng/mL. There is an<< interaction>> of cyclosporine on ever

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about unions, partnerships and things between parties, and away from unrelated words.
